$comment: Deployment configuration. Selected values have environment overrides; see docs/configuration.md. No repository name, remote URL, or Pages host is hardcoded in src/. The official project display name is exactly "Library of the Citadel" — a distinct project from Atom-KB's separate Library; neither mirrors, syncs, nor supersedes the other.
tagline: A visual hall for world knowledge.

citadel.label: Cyber Citadel
citadel.note: Citadel backlink is unset by default. Set citadel.url (or LIBRARY_CITADEL_URL) once the owner provisions the address; while it is empty the build renders a disabled placeholder instead of inventing a destination.

buildNotice: Mixed build. Six records are sourced: their cooking facts are summarized in this project's own words from the pages they cite and checked against them, but none has been cooked or tested here and none has had a professional food-safety review. Three records are illustrative fixtures that demonstrate the content contract. No record is publication-ready.
footerNote: Library of the Citadel — an independent static Library framework, distinct from Atom-KB's separate Library. No backend, no tracking, no external asset requests.
